skills.name: caveman
skills.purpose: Terse reply style: answer first, no filler, every technical fact kept. Gives all agents a short Thai voice.
skills.source: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman, skills/caveman/SKILL.md (unmodified copy, upstream commit 2178ed6495c3, compared 2026-11-24)

skills.name: tba-brainstorming
skills.purpose: Design conversation for TBA PlanMan: read the card and repo first, fill a 5-area coverage ledger, ask only what the code cannot answer, offer approaches, write plan.md.
skills.source: adapted from the brainstorming skill of https://github.com/obra/superpowers and merged with the 5-phase checklist of the TBA design command

skills.name: ponytail
skills.purpose: Smallest complete change for TBA Flusher: reuse what exists, no extras. The approved plan stays the scope and tests stay required (see OPENBOT-ADAPTATION.md).
skills.source: provided by the repo owner (a pasted skill); original author not recorded
skills.license: MIT, as declared in the skill's own frontmatter (no copyright line available)

skills.name: tba-debug
skills.purpose: Root-cause diagnosis for TBA BugsJaeger: runnable repro, fail path from real state, ranked hypotheses with disproofs, ledger, root cause. Writes debug.md, never the fix.
skills.source: original text written for this bundle; ideas from the pstack principles fix-root-causes and prove-it-works (https://github.com/cursor/plugins, pstack, commit 792440e8a560a4a3f63748cdee70491ecd412982)
skills.license: Original to this bundle. The pstack ideas are MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Lauren Tan (text in skills/tba-debug/references/pstack-LICENSE.txt)

skills.name: tba-review
skills.purpose: Outsider review for TBQA: intent, trace the real path, prove claims by running, report with severity and evidence. Secrets are never quoted and the user decides what to fix.
skills.source: original text written for this bundle; ideas from the pstack principles prove-it-works and blast-radius (https://github.com/cursor/plugins, pstack, commit 792440e8a560a4a3f63748cdee70491ecd412982)
